feature.label: World Cup
feature.title: The World Cup is on, and SoKno's got a screen for it
feature.deck: Five matches roll through the weekend — group-stage drama Friday and Saturday, then the first knockout on Sunday. Pull up a stool at one of the neighborhood's sports-screen spots and settle in.

facts.label: Where
facts.value: Kern's, Alliance, South Coast & Southside Garage

body.text: The world's biggest tournament is in our backyard this summer, and this weekend the group stage hits its final, frantic rounds before the bracket begins. You don't have to drive downtown to catch it — pull up a stool at one of South Knoxville's sports-screen spots and let the neighborhood do the cheering.

body.text: If you post up for just one, make it Saturday night: Argentina, the reigning World Cup champions, take on Jordan at ten — the marquee match of the weekend.

stories.label: Island Home
stories.title: Matt Woods brings his Appalachian songbook to Trailhead
stories.deck: The East Tennessee songwriter plays a free, pet-friendly show on the Trailhead patio Saturday night — Americana with the roots showing.

facts.label: Where
facts.value: Trailhead Beer Market, 1317 Island Home Ave

body.text: Matt Woods is a product of Appalachia, and you can hear East Tennessee tangled all through his songs — call it Americana, folk-rock, or just country with the roots showing. He's spent most of his life on the road, solo or with his band the Natural Disasters, and by his own telling he's just trying to share some truth and get along.

— heady company for a free patio show. Bring the dog; it's pet-friendly and outdoors.

body.text: It's on the patio at Trailhead Beer Market on Island Home, Saturday at seven, and it won't cost you a thing.

stories.label: Old Sevier
stories.title: An afternoon soirée of local makers at The Pink Cactus
stories.deck: Sunday afternoon, Old Sevier leans into summer: a curated artisan market on the Pink Cactus patio, one to five.

body.text: Summer's here, so it's time to soirée. The Old Sevier Summer Soirée Market sets up at The Pink Cactus on Sunday afternoon with a curated lineup of local vendors and makers — handmade goods, summer vibes, and plenty of reasons to spend a slow afternoon on Sevier Avenue.
It runs one to five. Browse, sip, and take home something made by a neighbor.

stories.label: Ijams Park
stories.title: An evening paddle on the river, kayaks provided
stories.deck: Friday evening, Legacy Parks puts you on the Tennessee River off Ijams Park — boats, paddles, and life jackets included, all skill levels welcome.

facts.label: Where
facts.value: Ijams Nature Center, 2915 Island Home Ave

body.text: There's no better way to end a Friday than two slow hours on the water. Legacy Parks' Evening Paddle launches from Ijams Park onto the Tennessee River, with kayaks, canoes, paddles, and life jackets provided and staff on hand to get first-timers comfortable. Families, couples, anybody who wants to unwind — all skill levels are welcome.
Space is limited, so register ahead. Then just show up and let the river do the rest.

stories.label: Old Sevier
stories.title: Eight comics stack the bill at the After Brunch Special
stories.deck: Saturday afternoon, eight comedians take the Pink Cactus stage for a stand-up showcase — doors at two, show at two-thirty.

body.text: The Pink Cactus hands its stage to a deep comedy bench Saturday afternoon: the After Brunch Special lines up Jesse James Best, Brody Lawson, Saxton Constant, Savannah Wolfgram, Clinton Ricks, Daniel Castillo, Caleb Friedrich, and Justin Chavez for one afternoon of stand-up.
Doors are at two, the show's at two-thirty, and tickets run ten ahead or fifteen at the door.

stories.label: Old Sevier
stories.title: Hi-Wire packs the weekend: trivia, a dance party, and stained glass
stories.deck: The taproom runs the table this weekend — Friday trivia, a late-night Afro-fusion dance party Saturday, and a hands-on stained-glass class Sunday.

body.text: Hi-Wire's taproom stays busy all weekend. Friday it's Twilight Trivia at seven — round up a team and a few pints. Saturday night turns into an Afro Fusion Party from nine to midnight. And Sunday afternoon a hands-on Stained Glass Class runs from two to four, for anyone who'd rather make something.
Times and details live on Hi-Wire's Instagram — worth a look before you head over.
